name: KHEESAN
recent: Khee San 近期与 Paul Lim 及杂货商签署谅解备忘录，计划开发零售数字化平台。公司同时面临一项涉及 RM66m 的诉讼，源于土地交易纠纷，但子公司银行账户的冻结令已解除。最新季度财报显示营收同比增长 20.9%，并转亏为盈。
notable: 与 Paul Lim 及杂货商签署谅解备忘录，开发零售数字化平台。
子公司银行账户的冻结令已解除。
面临总额 RM66m 的诉讼索赔，涉及土地交易纠纷。
risks: 公司面临总额 RM66m 的诉讼索赔，涉及土地交易纠纷。
执行董事 Miss Ngu Chienn Ying 于 2026 年 8 月 27 日处置 30,000,000 股普通股（占 2.444%）。
独立非执行董事 Puan Suzana Manja Binti Ibrahim 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日处置 600,000 股普通股（占 0.049%）。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度，营收为 MYR 16.9m，同比增长 20.9%，环比增长 19.7%；净利润为 MYR 1.082m，净利率 6.4%，较去年同期的净亏损大幅改善。

recent_en: Khee San recently signed an MoU with Paul Lim and sundry goods merchants to develop a retail digitalisation platform. The company is also facing RM66m litigation arising from a land deal dispute, though a freezing order on its subsidiary's bank accounts has been lifted. The latest quarterly results show revenue up 20.9% YoY and a return to profitability.
notable_en: Signed an MoU with Paul Lim and sundry goods merchants to develop a retail digitalisation platform.
Freezing order on subsidiary's bank accounts lifted.
Facing RM66m in litigation claims related to a land deal dispute.
risks_en: The company faces RM66m in litigation claims related to a land deal dispute.
Executive Director Miss Ngu Chienn Ying disposed of 30,000,000 ordinary shares (2.444%) on 27 Aug 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Director Puan Suzana Manja Binti Ibrahim disposed of 600,000 ordinary shares (0.049%) on 15 Oct 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 16.9m, up 20.9% YoY and 19.7% QoQ; net income was MYR 1.082m with a net margin of 6.4%, a significant improvement from a net loss a year earlier.
